arxiv-1509-02443.title: Signal photon flux generated by high-frequency relic gravitational waves
arxiv-1509-02443.creator: Xin Li 1,2, Sai Wang 2, Hao Wen 1,2
arxiv-1509-02443.description: A 2015 arXiv research paper by Xin Li 1,2, Sai Wang 2, Hao Wen 1,2. The power spectrum of primordial tensor perturbations 𝒫 t \mathcal{P}_{t} increases rapidly in high frequency region if the spectral index n t > 0 n_{t}>0 .

arxiv-2111-05710.title: Object Servoing of Differential-Drive Robots
arxiv-2111-05710.creator: Weibin Jia \aref wrjs, Wenjie Zhao \aref wrjs, Zhihuan Song \aref gkll and Zhengguo Li \aref lsxx
arxiv-2111-05710.description: Abstract Due to possibly changing pose of a movable object and nonholonomic constraint of a differential-drive robot, it is challenging to design an object servoing scheme for the differential-drive robot to asymptotically park at a predefined relative pose to the movable object. In this paper, a novel object servoing scheme is designed for the differential-drive robots.

arxiv-2204-05957.title: Localization Distillation for Object Detection Thanks: Z. Zheng, Q. Hou and M.M. Cheng are with TMCC, CS, Nankai University, Tianjin, China. E-mail: Zh_zheng@mail.nankai.edu.cn; {houqb,cmm}@nankai.edu.cn R. Ye and P. Wang are with the School of Mathematics, Tianjin University, China. E-mail: {emento
arxiv-2204-05957.creator: Zhaohui Zheng, Rongguang Ye, Qibin Hou, Dongwei Ren, Ping Wang
arxiv-2204-05957.description: Abstract Previous knowledge distillation (KD) methods for object detection mostly focus on feature imitation instead of mimicking the prediction logits due to its inefficiency in distilling the localization information. In this paper, we investigate whether logit mimicking always lags behind feature imitation.

arxiv-2206-09230.title: A Simple Proof of 𝖯𝗋𝖾𝖼𝗂𝗌𝖾𝖰𝖬𝖠 = 𝖯𝖲𝖯𝖠𝖢𝖤 \mathsf{PreciseQMA}=\mathsf{PSPACE}
arxiv-2206-09230.creator: Yulong Li
arxiv-2206-09230.description: Abstract We give an alternative proof of 𝖯𝗋𝖾𝖼𝗂𝗌𝖾𝖰𝖬𝖠 = 𝖯𝖲𝖯𝖠𝖢𝖤 \mathsf{PreciseQMA}=\mathsf{PSPACE} , first proved by Fefferman and Lin ( Innov. Theor. Comp. Sci. 2018 ), where 𝖯𝗋𝖾𝖼𝗂𝗌𝖾𝖰𝖬𝖠 \mathsf{PreciseQMA} is the class Quantum Merlin-Arthur with inverse exponential completeness-soundness gap. We adapt the proof of Quantum Cook-Levin Theorem to prove the inclusion 𝖯𝖲𝖯𝖠𝖢𝖤 ⊆ 𝖯𝗋𝖾𝖼𝗂𝗌𝖾𝖰𝖬𝖠 \mathsf{PSPACE}\subseteq\mathsf{PreciseQMA} .

arxiv-2305-05805.title: Quantum Fokker-Planck structure of the Lindblad equation
arxiv-2305-05805.creator: Mário J. de Oliveira
arxiv-2305-05805.description: Abstract We show that the quantum Fokker-Planck equation, obtained by a canonical quantization of its classical version, can be transformed into an equation of the Lindblad form. This result allows us to conclude that the quantum Fokker-Planck equation preserves the trace and positivity of the density operator.

arxiv-2308-01475.title: Interpretable Machine Learning for Discovery: Statistical Challenges & Opportunities
arxiv-2308-01475.creator: Genevera I. Allen, Luqin Gan, Lili Zheng
arxiv-2308-01475.description: Abstract New technologies have led to vast troves of large and complex datasets across many scientific domains and industries. People routinely use machine learning techniques to not only process, visualize, and make predictions from this big data, but also to make data-driven discoveries.

arxiv-2308-05790.title: A dependence of binary and planetary system destruction on subtle variations in the substructure in young star-forming regions
arxiv-2308-05790.creator: Richard J. Parker
arxiv-2308-05790.description: Abstract Simulations of the effects of stellar fly-bys on planetary systems in star-forming regions show a strong dependence on subtle variations in the initial spatial and kinematic substructure of the regions. For similar stellar densities, the more substructured star-forming regions disrupt up to a factor of two more planetary systems.

arxiv-2402-01294.title: Minimizing Regret in Billboard Advertisement under Zonal Influence Constraint
arxiv-2402-01294.creator: Dildar Ali, Suman Banerjee, Yamuna Prasad
arxiv-2402-01294.description: Abstract In a typical billboard advertisement technique, a number of digital billboards are owned by an influence provider , and many advertisers approach the influence provider for a specific number of views of their advertisement content on a payment basis.

arxiv-2507-12139.title: Hexagonal 3-webs of circles with polar twisted cubic
arxiv-2507-12139.creator: Sergey I. Agafonov
arxiv-2507-12139.description: Abstract The paper describes and classifies hexagonal circular 3-webs on unit sphere such that the polar points of the web circles lie on a twisted cubic, thus completing classification of hexagonal circular 3-webs with algebraic polar curves of degree three. MSC: 53A60.

arxiv-2602-22057.title: Quantum tomography for non-iid sources
arxiv-2602-22057.creator: Leonardo Zambrano
arxiv-2602-22057.description: Abstract Quantum state and process tomography are typically analyzed under the assumption that devices emit independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) states or channels. In realistic experiments, however, noise, drift, feedback, or adversarial behavior violate this assumption. We show that projected least-squares tomography remains statistically optimal even under fully adaptive state and channel preparation.

britannica-1911-st-thomas-ontario.title: St Thomas (Ontario) (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-st-thomas-ontario.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-st-thomas-ontario.description: Article 'St Thomas (Ontario)' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 24), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Canada, capital of Elgin county, on Kettle creek, 13 m. It is an important station on the Grand Trunk, Michigan Central, Lake Erie & Detroit River, and Canadian Pacific railways. It has numerous schools, a collegiate institute, and Alma ladies’ college. The Michigan Central railway shops, car-wheel foundry, flour, flax and planing mills are the principal industries.

pmc-10500890.title: A feminist approach to eating disorders in China: a qualitative study
pmc-10500890.creator: Su Holmes, Hua Ma
pmc-10500890.description: BackgroundAs women continue to be more at risk from eating disorders, gender has often been a focus of concern in transcultural research. Yet feminist, qualitative studies which prioritize the voices of women/girls remain rare within transcultural work suggesting the need for greater interaction between these fields.

pmc-11519277.title: Achieving view-distance and -angle invariance in motion prediction using a simple network
pmc-11519277.creator: Haichuan Zhao, Xudong Ru, Peng Du, Shaolong Liu, Na Liu, Xingce Wang, Zhongke Wu
pmc-11519277.description: Recently, human motion prediction has gained significant attention and achieved notable success. However, current methods primarily rely on training and testing with ideal datasets, overlooking the impact of variations in the viewing distance and viewing angle, which are commonly encountered in practical scenarios.

pmc-11682012.title: Photodegradation of Dacarbazine Catalyzed by Vitamin B2 and Flavin Adenine Dinucleotide Under Visible-Light Irradiation
pmc-11682012.creator: Yuka Kimura, Mayuko Suga, Kayo Nakamura, Hidetsugu Tabata, Tetsuta Oshitari, Hideaki Natsugari, Hideyo Takahashi
pmc-11682012.description: PurposeDrug photodegradation is a matter of great concern because it can result in potency loss and adverse side effects. This study examines the light-induced degradation of dacarbazine catalyzed by vitamin B2 and flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD) under light-emitting diode (LED) or fluorescent light irradiation.

pmc-11691067.title: ACCEPTABILITY OF THE RESOURCE CONNECTION FOR RURAL CAREGIVERS OF PEOPLE LIVING WITH DEMENTIA
pmc-11691067.creator: Sydney Hoel, Lillian White, Matthew Zuraw, Jordan Hill, Christian Elliot, Andrew Pickett, Nicole Werner
pmc-11691067.description: Rural family caregivers of people living with Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD) experience higher caregiver burden and lower social supports compared to urban ADRD caregivers. However, research regarding how to better connect rural ADRD caregivers to resources in the community is lacking.

pmc-12508236.title: The yeast checkpoint kinase Mec1p functions in transcription termination by facilitating recruitment of Pcf11p and regulating the torpedo exonuclease Rat1p
pmc-12508236.creator: Riddhi Mehta, Fatema Zohra Sadia, Suprataptha U Reddy, Ivana Vancurova, Ales Vancura
pmc-12508236.description: Transcription cycle of RNA polymerase II (RNAPII) features three stages: initiation, elongation, and termination. Termination, closely linked with pre-mRNA 3’ processing, dissociates RNAPII from DNA and releases the nascent RNA transcript. Efficient termination is required for maintaining a pool of RNAPII that is available for re-entry into new transcription cycle.

pmc-12550196.title: Ultrasonic-assisted Haematococcus pluvialis protein-pectin complex significantly enhances DHA stability and bioavailability for 3D food printing☆
pmc-12550196.creator: Bin Li, Xu Zhong, Xinlei Zhang, Yinxu Zhang, Xinghua Gao, Xiaomei Liu, Wentao Su, Yuxiao Wang
pmc-12550196.description: Developing a highly stable and bioavailable docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) delivery system is critical for functional food applications especially in 3D food printing. This study introduces an ultrasonic-assisted Haematococcus pluvialis protein-pectin (HP/P) complex as a novel natural Pickering emulsifier to enhance DHA stability and bioavailability. HP/P complexes were prepared via 25 kHz ultrasonic treatment for 0–40 min.

pmc-13635092.title: Structural basis for rosuvastatin-induced activation of skeletal muscle ryanodine receptor 1
pmc-13635092.creator: Gunnar Weninger, Steven Reiken, Qi Yuan, Marco C Miotto, Alexander Chang, Yang Liu, Anetta Wronska, Haikel Dridi, Andrew R Marks
pmc-13635092.description: Statin therapies, used to lower high blood cholesterol, have been proposed to cause skeletal muscle side effects including myalgia and rhabdomyolysis. The ryanodine receptor 1 (RyR1)/Ca²⁺ release channel in skeletal muscle has recently been identified as an off-target binder of statins. Here, we report the cryo-electron microscopy structure of RyR1 in complex with rosuvastatin.
